answer: An identity earns its seat only when independent curators stake credits on its work. Each curator locks 80 credits per endorsement and backs at most four identities per epoch, so the tenth fake still needs a tenth fresh stake. Endorsements stay sealed until challenged: if the work proves hollow, the stake burns and the curator is barred for one epoch. Rented endorsements burn the same way: the renter is named. A saffron dye marks each endorsement in the grove ledger, exposing one curator behind many clones. One thousand fakes tie up 80,000 credits; an honest agent needs one endorsement.
